{{short description|British physicist}}
'''Colin George Windsor''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (born 28 June 1938) is a British [[physicist]], and was Programme Area Manager, for the [[United Kingdom Atomic Energy Authority]]

==Life==

He was born in London and attended Beckenham and Penge Grammar School. He won a scholarship to [[Magdalen College, Oxford]], earning a BA with [[First Class Honours]] in Physics, and a DPhil in 1963.<ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.colin.windsor.talktalk.net/sciencestory/ScienceStory.htm| title = Colin Windsor 1938 - : His Science story| access-date = 2012-02-23}}</ref>

He conducted magnetic resonance research, at [[Clarendon Laboratory]] in 1963. He was Resident Fellow at [[Yale University]] in 1964.
He conducted Neutron scattering research, at the [[Atomic Energy Research Establishment]], Harwell from 1964 to 1998.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://freespace.virgin.net/colin.windsor/wwho.htm |title=Who's Who Entry |access-date=2011-11-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303231813/http://freespace.virgin.net/colin.windsor/wwho.htm |archive-date=2016-03-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He won the [[Duddell Medal and Prize]] in 1987.

He was elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] in 1995 <ref>{{cite web| url = http://freespace.virgin.net/colin.windsor/cv.htm| title = Curriculum Vitae: Colin Windsor| access-date = 2012-02-23| archive-url = https://archive.today/20120711100312/http://freespace.virgin.net/colin.windsor/cv.htm| archive-date = 2012-07-11| url-status = dead}}</ref>

From 1998 to 2013 he was a consultant at [[Culham Centre for Fusion Energy]].

From 2013 to 2023 he was a consultant to the Oxfordshire fusion company [[Tokamak Energy]].

==Works==
*''Pulsed Neutron Scattering'', Taylor & Francis, 1981, {{ISBN|978-0-470-27131-5}}
*''Four computer models for the [[ZX81]] micro-computer'', C.G. Windsor, 1983, {{ISBN|978-0-9509197-0-6}}
*D. L. Weaire, Colin G. Windsor (eds) ''Solid state science: past, present, and predicted'', A. Hilger, 1987, {{ISBN|978-0-85274-584-7}}
